work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilities- Guarantee product quality and airworthiness by taking full responsibility for design approval according to established processes- Develop and optimize metal, composite, and hybrid components and assemblies with regard to weight, cost, performance, manufacturing, and assembly requirements.- Collaborate in multifunctional teams alongside structural analysis, production, program, project, configuration, and systems functions to achieve optimal technical solutions.- Evaluate design changes, estimate implementation efforts, and ensure full compliance with regulations, design principles, and guidelines.- Manage engineering partner and supplier activities, serving as their key technical contact.- Drive digitalization and automation innovations actively, taking all relevant regulations and stakeholders into account.Desired skills and qualifications- Technical university degree or similar professional qualification.- First experience in structural design.- Solid understanding of metal, composite, and hybrid design principles, including manufacturing/assembly requirements and tolerance definition.- Practical knowledge in project management and motivation to work with agile methodologies.- Hands-on proficiency with CATIA V5 and a PLM tool.- Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills to align diverse stakeholders, foster continuous improvement, and achieve team goals.
